rule: Implementation references GAS pattern IDs/names. External product names are not implementation requirements.

patterns.name: ConsumerAccountEntry
patterns.intent: Enter GAS through a consumer account mental model before exposing wallet/network implementation details.
truthConstraints: Do not imply custodial/non-custodial status incorrectly
Recovery and key ownership must remain discoverable
No RPC/chain/native-gas prerequisite in normal onboarding
acceptance: Normal first screen uses consumer identity language
No seed phrase/RPC/chain vocabulary in normal onboarding
Canceled/failed sign-in returns to a stable state

patterns.name: TruthfulUnifiedAccount
patterns.intent: Give the user one coherent GAS account while keeping financially distinct values semantically separate.
truthConstraints: Spendable GAS/USDC is distinct from locked wager amounts
Marked Bracket value is distinct from cash
Potential payout is distinct from current value
Monetary reserve and GameBankroll are never user balance
acceptance: One headline account value may be shown only with truthful component semantics
Spendable amount is always identifiable
Protocol reserves never inflate personal account value

patterns.name: BoundedPlayPermission
patterns.intent: Move repetitive signing friction to one explicit, human-readable, bounded authorization boundary.
truthConstraints: Token, amount/scope and expiry are explicit
Permission is revocable
Expired/revoked permission cannot silently renew
Normal gameplay may avoid wallet prompts only inside valid scope
acceptance: 0 wallet prompts for eligible Play after valid permission
Permission expansion always requires deliberate approval
Expiry produces one clear reauthorization path

patterns.name: SensitiveActionStepUp
patterns.intent: Apply stronger authentication at high-consequence boundaries without burdening ordinary browsing/play.
truthConstraints: Withdrawal, permission expansion and key/security changes are high-consequence
Authentication level cannot silently downgrade
acceptance: Routine eligible actions do not inherit withdrawal-level friction
Sensitive actions cannot complete without required challenge
Cancel returns to unchanged financial state

patterns.name: ContextualOnboarding
patterns.intent: Teach a concept only when the user first needs it, with deeper detail one disclosure layer away.
truthConstraints: Onboarding cannot obscure risk/fee facts
Dismissed education cannot remove mandatory disclosures
acceptance: No mandatory long tutorial before core product comprehension
Risk/rebase/reserve explanation appears at first relevant context
Full mechanics reachable in <=1 additional disclosure

patterns.name: RiskModeSelector
patterns.intent: Make CRUISE, BOOST and REDLINE the primary understandable risk choice.
truthConstraints: Risk distinction cannot rely on color alone
Underlying odds/RTP/payout information remains accessible
Changing mode does not silently change wager amount unless policy explicitly requires it
acceptance: Mode switch is 1 action
Mode labels and supporting copy communicate relative risk without docs
Selected state is programmatically exposed

patterns.name: WagerComposer
patterns.intent: Keep amount, asset and risk configuration adjacent to IGNITION with minimal state loss between rounds.
truthConstraints: Available balance and wager asset are visible
Permission/bankroll constraints are authoritative
No wager submits from an invalid state
acceptance: Returning eligible user reaches valid wager with <=2 intentional actions
Amount is not reset by ordinary mode switch
Invalid state explains one corrective action

patterns.name: IgnitionControl
patterns.intent: Provide one dominant deliberate action for committing an eligible wager with immediate acknowledgement and no duplicate-submit path.
truthConstraints: Button feedback is not settlement
Duplicate press cannot create duplicate wager
Disabled reason is explainable
Final commitment is always deliberate
acceptance: Primary Play CTA is visible without required mobile scroll
Press acknowledgement is immediate
A second press while intent is unresolved cannot create another intent

patterns.name: CanonicalActionState
patterns.intent: Represent every financial/game action through durable canonical states that survive refresh, reconnect and stale local UI.
truthConstraints: Optimistic feedback never invents finality
Stale intents do not execute after expiry
Retry reconciles existing intent before creating a new one
Refresh restores exact canonical status
acceptance: Refresh mid-round restores the exact round/wager
Connectivity loss cannot turn repeated retries into duplicate actions
Every terminal state is distinguishable

patterns.name: DualSpeedPresentation
patterns.intent: Decouple canonical result state from presentation speed.
truthConstraints: All modes render the same canonical result
Instant mode cannot hide unresolved state
Reduced motion is functional rather than decorative
acceptance: Presentation mode changes animation only, not game outcome or settlement
Reduced-motion preference is honored
Returning expert may bypass repeated cinematic delay

patterns.name: ResultActionRail
patterns.intent: A settled result always exposes the next best actions: replay, share, verify and inspect round.
truthConstraints: Replay only enabled when eligible
Share uses settled/verified facts
Verify links to canonical round data
No result card auto-wagers
acceptance: Settled result -> next IGNITION is 1 action
Result exposes GAS delta and new balance
Share/Verify each reachable in <=2 actions

patterns.name: VerifiedEconomicObject
patterns.intent: Represent game/trade/rebase/reserve activity as a social object with verifiable protocol facts and separately authored commentary.
truthConstraints: Canonical facts and user commentary are visually/data-model distinct
Object carries source/provenance state
Contextual action requires explicit user confirmation
acceptance: Every economic social object has canonical activity ID
Verified state is visible
Result object can preconfigure a game without submitting it

patterns.name: GlobalFollowingFeed
patterns.intent: Use one canonical activity stream with Global/Following/Crew/context filters rather than separate community systems.
truthConstraints: No fake activity
Recommendation/ranking provenance is inspectable where material
Following filter derives from one product-wide graph
acceptance: Filter switch is in-context
Returning from drilldown preserves filter/position where feasible
Empty state has a useful discovery path

patterns.name: IdentityPerformanceCard
patterns.intent: Let a user understand who someone is and what verified GAS activity supports their reputation before following/joining.
truthConstraints: Verified protocol metrics are separated from self-authored bio
Do not imply skill from insufficient sample size
Wallet address is secondary technical identity, not primary display identity
acceptance: Performance/context visible before Follow
Profile links to canonical activity
Follow state is reversible and product-wide

patterns.name: CrewMembershipCard
patterns.intent: Make Crew discovery/joining a social-game identity action with transparent rules and reversible membership.
truthConstraints: Join conditions and rewards are explicit
No hidden financial authorization is bundled with joining
Ranking/reward metrics require anti-sybil design
acceptance: Rules and key social proof visible before join
Joining does not create a wager/trade
Leave/revoke is discoverable

patterns.name: ContextPreservingDrilldown
patterns.intent: Allow deep inspection without destroying the user's source context.
truthConstraints: Deep-linked detail works without prior client state
Restoration is best-effort and never overrides canonical financial state
acceptance: Back returns to prior filter/timeframe
Source scroll restored where technically safe
Direct URL to detail remains valid

patterns.name: QuickTradeSheet
patterns.intent: Make Buy/Sell GAS simple by default while keeping all financially material facts visible before confirmation.
truthConstraints: Amount, fees, estimated/minimum received and materially relevant price impact visible before confirmation
Sell/withdraw is not intentionally harder to find than Buy
Quote expiry/staleness is explicit
acceptance: No manual contract address or RPC setup
Buy/Sell primary path requires no advanced order-book knowledge
Final confirmation is explicit

patterns.name: ProgressiveMarketDepth
patterns.intent: Keep advanced chart/order/depth controls one layer deeper than the default consumer action.
truthConstraints: Simple view cannot hide fees/impact
Advanced view does not create a second account/portfolio model
acceptance: Simple action remains available when advanced tools exist
Advanced depth returns to same canonical position/account state

patterns.name: PersonalRebaseMoment
patterns.intent: Explain an upcoming/completed rebase as a personal balance event before exposing the control law.
truthConstraints: Positive rebase is not described as guaranteed yield
Negative rebase is not hidden
Before/after balance comes from canonical share/index math
Reserve context is truthful
acceptance: Direction, magnitude and personal before/after understandable at a glance
Next rebase state visible
Control-law detail reachable one disclosure deeper

patterns.name: ReserveTrustSurface
patterns.intent: Make GAS external backing understandable and independently inspectable without mixing monetary and game accounting.
truthConstraints: GAS/wGAS/self-issued LP side excluded from external backing
GameBankroll excluded
Future Bracket collateral separate
Data timestamps/valuation source visible at detail level
acceptance: Home-level summary answers coverage at a glance
Composition and verification one level deeper
Stale reserve data is labeled, never silently presented as current

patterns.name: HumanRecoveryNotice
patterns.intent: When something fails or stalls, first tell the user the financial state, then offer the smallest safe next action.
truthConstraints: No raw RPC/revert text as primary message
Safe-to-retry label requires authoritative reconciliation
Technical details remain available secondarily
acceptance: Every financial error answers whether money moved or remains pending
Exactly one recommended safe action is prominent
Refresh/reconnect can reconcile without duplicate action

patterns.name: UnifiedDiscovery
patterns.intent: Use one search/discovery primitive for players, Crews, games, transactions and later Bracket markets.
truthConstraints: Result types are clearly distinguished
Relevant action is contextual but never auto-executes
acceptance: One search entry point
Users and financial/game objects visually differentiated
No-result state offers useful recovery

patterns.name: DeepLinkedNotification
patterns.intent: Return the user directly to the relevant canonical object/state instead of a generic home screen.
truthConstraints: Deep link reconciles stale state before showing action
Notification content cannot imply settlement before canonical settlement
acceptance: Settlement/follow/Crew/rebase notification reaches relevant detail directly
Stale notification degrades gracefully
No home detour required

patterns.name: BracketOutcomeCard
patterns.intent: Present future Bracket event/outcome positions in human event language before exchange plumbing.
truthConstraints: Probability is market-implied, not objective truth
Cash/current value/potential payout/executable proceeds are distinct
Liquidity/price impact visible when material
Bracket solvency remains separate from GAS monetary reserve
acceptance: Event/outcome/probability meaning understandable before order-book terminology
Quick path and advanced depth share same position state
Exit path is discoverable before resolution
